remarks: Welcome to 41 Liberty Street—an impeccably maintained, nearly new (’21) RANCH style home offering elevated finishes, exceptional indoor living & an outdoor OASIS. Ideally located just moments from downtown Fredonia’s shops & dining, this residence blends modern comfort w/ refined design. Inside, a beautifully curated open-concept layout showcases vaulted tongue-and-groove ceilings, luxury vinyl plank flooring, & thoughtfully selected custom details throughout. The gourmet kitchen features quartz countertops, custom soft-close cabinetry, black stainless-steel appliances, & striking copper accents—seamlessly flowing into a bright, inviting living space designed for effortless entertaining. The spacious primary suite is a true retreat, complete w/ dual walk-in closets & a spa-inspired bath featuring a custom double vanity, heated floors, & a luxurious five-piece walk-in shower. Two additional generously sized bedrooms are positioned alongside a second full bath with custom cabinetry & heated tile floors. Additional highlights include first-floor laundry, a functional mudroom, multiple coat closets, crown molding accents, ceiling fans in every bedroom, & attached 2 car garage. The partially finished, fully insulated & waterproofed basement offers a third full bathroom w/ heated floors, dual electrical panels, a high-efficiency furnace with central AC, hot water tank, & sump pump (all just 5 years young)—providing excellent potential for additional living space or storage. Step outside into your private backyard retreat, accessible through two sliding glass doors leading to a stunning Trex deck(40x12). Enjoy a heated in-ground fiberglass pool (16x38) & unwind beneath a Kohler retractable awning(12x20), offering the perfect balance of sun & shade. The fully fenced white vinyl yard is truly a beautiful space offering both serenity & privacy, while the adjacent detached barn adds exceptional versatility—featuring a half bath, pool changing area, & ample space for storage, vehicles, or recreation! A RARE opportunity to own a thoughtfully designed NEWER home that perfectly balances quality craftsmanship, modern luxury, & resort-style amenities! Showings begin immediately!
